_comment: Tee Time Agent Configuration — edit this file to update your preferences

preferredTimeRange.comment: Book Saturday tee times between 6:00am and 11:00am
Book Sunday tee times at reciprocal Access Advantage clubs

accessAdvantage.comment: Leave preferredClubs empty to check all available clubs, or list specific club names

booking._fallbackComment: If no slots exist in the preferred time window, book the earliest available slot instead of skipping
booking._clubTiersComment: Clubs listed first are preferred — used to break ties when multiple clubs have available slots

players._comment: Default guest — used automatically when booking 2 players
Second guest — use with: node book-tee-time.js --guest 2
Third guest — use with: node book-tee-time.js --guest 3

twilio._comment: Sign up at twilio.com — free trial gives ~$15 credit, more than enough

intelligence._comment: Clubs scoring below minClubReliabilityScore for a given day are skipped unless it's booking day

schedule.comment: Sunday 7am → book home club Saturday; Monday 7am → book Access Advantage Sunday.

powerbi._comment: Power BI Streaming Dataset — setup steps: app.powerbi.com → New → Streaming Dataset → API → create with schema below → paste the Push URL here
powerbi._schema: Define these fields when creating the dataset: ClubName(Text), Date(Text), DayOfWeek(Text), Time(Text), Hour(Number), SlotsAvailable(Number), InPreferredWindow(True/False), ScrapedAt(DateTime)
